aggressive.read: This aggressive plan targets ~4%/month growth, stretching for higher returns. It significantly increases exposure to leveraged ETFs and concentrates in high-scoring setups. Be aware this raises both upside and drawdown potential, with leveraged ETFs subject to daily decay and rebalancing. Strict stop discipline is crucial to manage substantial risk.
